== Reward == {{Gear Set |Woven Grass Headband |Woven Grass Chestguard |Woven Grass Vambraces |Woven Grass Bracelet |Woven Grass Gauntlets |Woven Grass Greaves |Woven Grass Boots }} == Checklist == Turn-ins to [[Qynydd Fe`Dhar]] in [[Skyshrine]].{{CheckboxList}} *[[Woven Grass Headband]] :*[[Unadorned Leather Cap]] :*3x [[Crushed Onyx Sapphire]] *[[Woven Grass Chestguard]] :*[[Unadorned Leather Tunic]] :*3x [[Black Marble]] *[[Woven Grass Vambraces]] :*[[Unadorned Leather Sleeves]] :*3x [[Jaundice Gem]] *[[Woven Grass Bracelet]] :*[[Unadorned Leather Bracelet]] :*3x [[Crushed Opal]] *[[Woven Grass Gauntlets]] :*[[Unadorned Leather Gloves]] :*3x [[Crushed Lava Ruby]] *[[Woven Grass Greaves]] :*[[Unadorned Leather Leggings]] :*3x [[Chipped Onyx Sapphire]] *[[Woven Grass Boots]] :*[[Unadorned Leather Boots]] :*3x [[Crushed Flame Emerald]] {{End}} == Walkthrough == Qynydd Fe`Dhar is located in a room in the Skyshrine Tower TOP level. First room after you zone into the top after clicking on the SECOND orb. (The room has all 14 armor quest NPC's on [[Claws of Veeshan]] faction, he is on the left side.) You say, 'Hail, Qynydd Fe`Dhar' : Qynydd Fe`Dhar says 'Greetings to you. I seek one who calls himself a druid. What do you call yourself, manling?' You say, 'I am a druid' : Qynydd Fe`Dhar says 'Good. I had hoped you were one. As nature's guardian, you fight the never-ending struggle against those who seek to defile it. It is an admirable quality and I wish to aid you. I will provide you with a cap, a tunic, sleeves, bracers, gloves, leggings and boots.' '''Gems are dropped off various NPCs in [[Velketor's Labyrinth]], [[Siren's Grotto]], [[Cobalt Scar]] and [[The Wakening Land]]. Unadorned leather armor is dropped randomly in the Halls of Testing inside the [[Temple of Veeshan]]. Ally faction is required for all turn-ins.''' '''For each armor piece, bring the three gems and armor piece back and in exchange, you'll receive your reward, experience and faction.'''
* Your faction with [[Claws of Veeshan]] got better. * Your faction with [[Yelinak]] got better. * Your faction with [[Kromzek]] got worse.
{{exp}} == Cap == You say, 'What cap?' : Qynydd Fe`Dhar says 'I shall weave one of exceptional quality for you but you must gather the ingredients first. I require an unadorned leather cap and three crushed onyx sapphires.' Return with [[Unadorned Leather Cap]] and three [[Crushed Onyx Sapphire]]s. == Tunic == You say, 'What tunic?' : Qynydd Fe`Dhar says 'You shall be a force of nature with this tunic. Once I have gained an unadorned leather tunic and three pieces of black marble, the item is yours.' Return with [[Unadorned Leather Tunic]] and three [[Black Marble]] pieces. == Sleeves == You say, 'What sleeves?' : Qynydd Fe`Dhar says 'As the bark protects the limbs of the tree, so shall these sleeves protect your arms. Bring me a pair of unadorned leather sleeves and three jaundice gems.' Return with [[Unadorned Leather Sleeves]] and three [[Jaundice Gem]]s. == Bracelet == You say, 'What bracers?' : Qynydd Fe`Dhar says 'For a bracer I shall require an unadorned leather bracelet as well as three crushed opals. Do this and the reward shall be yours to keep.' Return with [[Unadorned Leather Bracelet]] and three [[Crushed Opal]]s. == Gloves == You say, 'What gloves?' : Qynydd Fe`Dhar says 'The gloves shall help protect you from the elements and harm. In order for me to complete them, I require a pair of unadorned leather gloves and three crushed lava rubies.' Return with [[Unadorned Leather Gloves]] and three [[Crushed Lava Ruby|Crushed Lava Rubies]]. == Leggings == You say, 'What leggings?' : Qynydd Fe`Dhar says 'As the roots support the mighty oak, so shall these leggings support you. Furnish me three chipped onyx sapphires and a pair of unadorned leather leggings.' Return with [[Unadorned Leather Leggings]] and three [[Chipped Onyx Sapphire]]s. == Boots == You say, 'What boots?' : Qynydd Fe`Dhar says 'Even the swiftest feet need protection so I shall provide you with these. They should help. Acquire a pair of unadorned boots and a set of three crushed flame emeralds and a new set of boots will be yours.' Return with [[Unadorned Leather Boots]] and three [[Crushed Flame Emerald]]s. == Fashion == Full sets of Woven Grass in various gender/races.
